errors.text: The hypothesis identifies 850–950 °C as optimal and treats 1000 °C as damaging, whereas the target result establishes 1000 °C as the optimum within the allowable processing window.
The proposed barrier is an unspecified intermetallic grain-boundary network, while the target mediator is a distribution of oxide phases such as AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The predicted density above 98% conflicts with the measured optimum of 96.7% relative density.
The oxidation experiment is conducted at 600 °C rather than the target condition of 900 °C and omits the required 3.5 wt% NaCl corrosion comparison.
